messages:
maya: Kicking off a small refresh for the Hello Quickstart: update auth to token-first examples and swap the legacy env names. Aim to keep the guide under one page.

oliver: I'll update deploy examples (Docker + Cloud Run). Prefer minimal runtimes: node:20 and python:3.11.

sam: I'll change the inline snippets. What's the exact env rename we should show?

maya: Replace REDWOOD_API_KEY with REDWOOD_TOKEN everywhere. Show both export and .env examples. Add a single migration note about rotating keys -> tokens.

lia: Can we include a short CLI example to create a token so folks don't have to open console? One-liner is fine.

maya: Good idea. Use: `redwoodctl tokens create --title "quickstart" --output json` and then show how to export the value as REDWOOD_TOKEN. Avoid exposing production instructions.

oliver: Dockerfile for node quickstart (minimal):
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

sam: Thanks. I'll add that and a short curl example for sanity-checking the token auth: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat`

lia: Suggest adding a tiny troubleshooting bullet: if you see 401s locally, confirm you exported REDWOOD_TOKEN in the same shell as you run the curl or the container env.

maya: Also add note about local .env taking precedence for demo runs and a pointer to production secrets best practices.

sam: Opening PR with changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201 — includes Dockerfile, curl/test snippet, migration blurb, and one-line troubleshooting.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4201--docs.redwood.ai (available 15m)

oliver: I'll validate Cloud Run env var examples tomorrow and check that the sample deploy logs show the Authorization header masked.

maya: If all looks good, let's merge before end of week. Small copy edits welcome on the PR.

sam: Noted. Assigning reviewers @maya @oliver @lia. CI lint and snippet tests passed locally.

lia: Small nit: in the migration blurb, change "rotate old keys" to "migrate keys to tokens" for clarity.

maya: Done in PR. Thanks everyone.
